The India Meteorological Department (IMD) issued a critical orange alert for today. Massive rainfall is expected across East Rajasthan and West Madhya Pradesh. The Vidarbha region also faces severe weather risks. These intense storms target cities like Jaipur, Indore, and Nagpur. Travelers must prepare for disruptions during the late afternoon and evening hours.
Intense spells will likely hit the Kota-Udaipur belt and the Indore-Bhopal corridor. Experts predict thunder and lightning in isolated pockets starting from the afternoon. Low-lying colonies in Ujjain and Amravati are at significant risk of flash floods. Residents must remain alert as water levels could rise very quickly in these urban sectors.
Heavy rain alerts for East Rajasthan and West MP impact highways
Road travel faces major challenges on the National Highway 27 (NH-27) and NH-48 corridors. Portions of NH-52 near Kota might experience heavy waterlogging or temporary roadblocks. Flash floods often disrupt these vital routes during intense monsoon spells. Drivers should check local road reports before starting long journeys across these specific regional states.
Air travel is also under threat today due to poor visibility conditions. Airports in Jaipur, Indore, and Nagpur expect significant departure and arrival delays. Ground operations often pause during heavy lightning for staff safety. Passengers should check their flight status directly with airlines to avoid long terminal waits.
Citizens must exercise caution near old trees and damaged power lines today. Urban flooding creates hazards in underpasses across Nagpur and Bhopal during peak hours. School pickups require extra time due to anticipated traffic congestion on city roads. Families should monitor live district nowcasts for the most accurate and recent weather updates.
The monsoon activity remains highly volatile across these central and western belts. Heavy rain could persist into the late night, affecting visibility for night drivers. Stay indoors during lightning events to ensure personal safety during these intense weather spells. Always verify local radar data before planning any outdoor movement or essential city travel.
